استرعفن (form X)
# اِسْتَرْعَفْنَ (istarʕafna) /is.tar.ʕaf.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَرْعَفَ (istarʕafa)
# اُسْتُرْعِفْنَ (usturʕifna) /us.tur.ʕif.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَرْعَفَ (istarʕafa)
# اِسْتَرْعِفْنَ (istarʕifna) /is.tar.ʕif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَرْعَفَ (istarʕafa)
